Schema_Description: Custom job schema for the NewAgent task creation and tracking system, managing individual task states and optional auditing. Each task carries its own task_context (embedded, chunked files), task_reference (path-only refs), and task_mandatory (marks a task as a required, built-in step for the job's Job_Type/Job_Subtype). Job_Type/Job_Subtype classify the job; Contextualize_Plan/Contextualize_Last control what each task is injected with at run time.
Job_Goal: Ensure 1:1 functional vanilla JavaScript parity across all application libraries in src/lib/lib_js/.
Values: Audit Exported Functions & Field Map Usage
Inspect module exports and ensure all BEJSON accesses use cached field maps.
Verify Browser Portability & Zero Node Modules
Confirm that mirrored files execute natively in modern web browsers without imports from node_modules.
